submission.natural_language_explanation: The pole fires on a preposition heading a circumstantial or complement PP that situates an actual event or factual claim in its frame — its time, place, condition, standard of comparison, content, cause, or deadline (in March, at sea level, with last year, of a galaxy, by Friday); the same tokens stay near zero as infinitive markers, particles, or verb-selected idioms, and event clauses with no PP at all stay near zero. Input attribution is left-loaded (mean distance 3.5 tokens back, nothing beyond 16 back) and the Jacobian lens promotes frame nouns (condition/premise/environment/situation), not any specific next token, so the mechanism is retrospective; weak-tail peaks on bare verbs, a code delimiter, and a word fragment are acknowledged leftovers.
